name: kanban
title: Kanban Board
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
description: A multi-container drag-and-drop board with a virtual state machine. Drag cards between columns, reorder columns, live placeholders during drag — committed once on drop.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/kanban. Wrap your board with KanbanRoot and pass columns and cards. Drag cards within and between columns, drag column headers to reorder. useKanban exposes the virtual drag state for custom column/card rendering.
